issue_context.title: Incorrect display of the "Score Position" since the 2025.220.0 update on Osu!Mania
issue_context.body:
### Type

Performance

### Bug description

Hello, 
Since the 2025.220.0 update, in witch we can now play with every skin in Android (thanks for this update we were waiting for), I encounter a problem concerning the display of the Score Position (where the accuracy of each note is shown) when I play with the skin I was used to (I think it does it with others skins too but I never tested them before the bug). 

The Score Position is now displayed at the bottom of the screen, when before it was displayed at the middle/top of the screen, so it ruined my accuracy since I'm used to read the notes at the middle of the screen.

I tried to change some value in the skin.ini file (by opening the skin file on Osu! Stable on PC), but putting an high or a low value at the "ScorePosition" value changed nothing when I tested back the new skin in Osu!Lazer, so I guess that in the new update, the "ScorePosition" value is no longer read correctly... It don't seem to be an huge bug to patch but it had an huge impact in my playstyle and because of that, I no longer enjoy playing right now...

An other person had the same problem as me on the Osu!Forum (while not having the same skin as me), but he don't respond back when a dev asked him more details, so I decided to report the bug here since I'm not the only one impacted. 
The Osu!Forum related to the problem : https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/topics/2043895?n=1

Others informations if you need it :
My profile : https://osu.ppy.sh/users/32033824/mania
The skin I'm using : https://mega.nz/file/YZhW1aqR#-8BGoozCHtfH722WW5Ty4k6Dzv5oo3W78UEa7O0rTpw
The device I'm using : Honor Pad 9 on Android 14 (MagicOS 8.0)

I hope you will be able to fix this bug soon because I really enjoy playing Osu!Mania on mobile 🙏
Thanks for reading all of this. 

### Screenshots or videos

Unfortunately, I don't have an screen of the skin before the update, so I can only show after the update :
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/436dc118-df31-4440-8247-ba7cf673d29c)
The "miss" position was at the middle/top of the screen before, so way higher than now...


And the screen of the other person having the same problem as me on the Osu!Forum (idk if he is on mobile or pc) :
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/21a41c98-7d96-41dd-8c9f-e4266818ba5b)

### Version

2025.220.0

### Logs

[logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19039225/logs.zip)

review_comments: Very unsure about this, but let's see how it plays out I guess...
